footnotes: Thanks to Graham Nicholson for informing me of the existence of this instrument.
signature: on garland, “MACHT IOHANN CARL KODISCH NVRNB 1698”; master’s mark, prancing horse with initials “I C K”.
mouthpiece: perhaps original; partially reconstructed. diam outside of rim 29.8, diam. of cup 18.7, grain or throat 4.2/3.3, depth of cup 8.6, total length 88, exit 8.2.
remarks:
Ring in slide-bow, bell-bow. Flat bell-stay has engraved floral-leaf pattern, similar to #1701. Garland has embossed shells on proximal border. Nuremberg-style rim-wire with braided floral-leaf pattern. Bell has typical wide flare common to Kodisch instruments.
